item.title: Bakersfield City Council approves City Lights' final map
item.description: The Bakersfield City Council approved the final map for City Lights at its Wednesday meeting, as well as an agreement for developers to complete all required improvement works at the site within one year.

item.title: Man found guilty of beating woman, holding gun to her head
item.description: BAKERSFIELD, Calif. (KGET) -- Following an argument with a woman he was dating, Jayden Toralba held a gun to her head, hit her in the face and stomach then choked her when she tried to leave, according to prosecutors. This week, a jury convicted Toralba of assault with a gun, false imprisonment and other charges. [...]

item.title: Maya Hernandez takes plea deal in child hot car death
item.description: A plea agreement has been reached in the case of a Visalia woman whose 1-year-old son died after she left him for hours in a car on a hot June day.
